en.t: Henry III confirms Drogo’s Norman territories
en.s: On 3 February 1047, Emperor Henry III accepted Drogo of Hauteville’s homage in southern Italy and confirmed his possession of the territories he already controlled as count of Apulia.
en.n: This is imperial recognition and investiture. Drogo had already succeeded his brother as count in 1046.

zh.t: 亨利三世确认德罗戈的诺曼领地
zh.s: 1047年2月3日，皇帝亨利三世在意大利南部接受奥特维尔的德罗戈效忠，并确认他作为阿普利亚伯爵已经控制的领地。
zh.n: 此条记录皇帝的确认与册封。德罗戈已于1046年接替兄长成为伯爵。

en.s: The Battle of Oslo was fought outside of Oslo on the night of 3 February 1161 between Haakon II of Norway and Inge I of Norway during the civil war era in Norway. As the son of Ingiríðr Ragnvaldsdóttir and king Harald Gille (making him the only legitimate son of Gille), Inge had been named king of Norway after Gille was killed by Sigurd Slembe.

zh.s: 1161年2月3日夜间，挪威内战时期的哈康二世与英格一世在奥斯陆城外交战。英格是英吉里德·拉格恩瓦尔兹多蒂尔与国王哈拉尔·吉勒之子，也是吉勒唯一的婚生儿子。吉勒被西居尔·斯莱姆贝杀害后，英格被拥立为挪威国王。

en.s: The Battle of Diu, sometimes referred to as the Second Battle of Chaul, was a naval battle fought on 3 February 1509 in the Arabian Sea, near the port of Diu, India, between the Portuguese Empire and a joint fleet of the Sultan of Gujarat, the Mamlûk Burji Sultanate of Egypt, the Zamorin of Calicut with support of Ottomans, the Republic of Venice and the Republic of Ragusa (Dubrovnik). The Portuguese victory was critical: the Mamluks and Arabs retreated, easing the Portuguese strategy of controlling the Indian Ocean to route trade down the Cape of Good Hope, circumventing the traditional spice route controlled by the Arabs and the Venetians through the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

zh.s: 第乌海战有时也称第二次绍尔海战，发生于1509年2月3日印度第乌港附近的阿拉伯海。葡萄牙帝国舰队与古吉拉特苏丹、埃及马穆鲁克布尔吉王朝及卡利卡特扎莫林组成的联合舰队交战，后者得到奥斯曼帝国、威尼斯共和国及拉古萨共和国、即杜布罗夫尼克的支持。葡萄牙取得关键胜利，马穆鲁克和阿拉伯势力撤退，使葡萄牙更易控制印度洋，将贸易引向好望角航线，绕开阿拉伯人和威尼斯人控制的红海、波斯湾传统香料贸易路线。

en.s: The Battle of Runafer (in Polish: Bitwa pod Kirempą) took place on 3 February 1567 near Reval (now Tallinn) during the Polish–Swedish War (1563–1568). The clash took place between Swedish forces led by Henrik Klasson Horn af Kanckas and Polish forces under the command of fältöverste Talwosa. The Swedes suffered defeat, losing 2,000 men.

zh.s: 鲁纳费尔战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Kirempą）于1567年2月3日在雷瓦尔（今塔林）附近爆发，属于波瑞战争（1563—1568年）的一部分。瑞典军队由亨里克·克拉松·霍恩·阿夫·坎卡斯率领，波兰军队由野战上校塔尔沃萨指挥。瑞典军队战败，损失2000人。

en.s: The Battle of São Vicente was a minor naval engagement that took place off Sao Vincente, Portuguese Brazil on 3 February 1583 during the Anglo–Spanish War between three English ships (including two galleons), and three Spanish galleons. The English under Edward Fenton on an expedition having failed to enter the Pacific, then attempted to trade off Portuguese Brazil but were intercepted by a detached Spanish squadron under Commodore Andrés de Equino. After a moonlit battle briefly interrupted by a rainstorm the Spanish were defeated with one galleon sunk and another heavily damaged along with heavy losses.

zh.s: 1583年2月3日，三艘英格兰舰船、其中两艘为盖伦帆船，与三艘西班牙盖伦帆船在葡属巴西圣维森特外海发生小规模海战。爱德华·芬顿率领的英格兰远征队未能进入太平洋，转而试图在葡属巴西沿岸贸易，却被安德烈斯·德·埃基诺准将率领的一支西班牙分舰队拦截。双方在月光下交战，期间因暴雨短暂停战。西班牙最终落败，一艘盖伦帆船沉没，另一艘严重受损，人员伤亡惨重。原文将其列入英西战争。

en.s: (For the battle in the 1982 Lebanon War, see Battle of the Beaufort (1982).) The Battle of Beaufort, also known as the Battle of Port Royal Island, was fought on February 3, 1779, near Beaufort, South Carolina, during the American Revolutionary War. The battle took place not long after British forces consolidated control around Savannah, Georgia, which they had captured in December 1778. Brigadier General Augustine Prevost sent 200 British regulars to seize Port Royal Island at the mouth of the Broad River in South Carolina in late January 1779.

zh.s: 博福特战役又称皇家港岛战役，发生于美国独立战争期间的1779年2月3日，地点在南卡罗来纳州博福特附近。此前不久，英军刚巩固对佐治亚州萨凡纳周边的控制，他们在1778年12月攻占该城。1779年1月底，奥古斯丁·普雷沃斯特准将派出200名英国正规军，前往夺取南卡罗来纳州布罗德河河口的皇家港岛。

en.s: The Battle of Young's House (also known as the Battle of Young's Corners, Affair at Youngs House, and Action at Youngs Corners) was a skirmish fought outside New York City between British and American forces on February 3, 1780, during the American Revolutionary War. A British force attacked and destroyed a Continental Army outpost in Westchester County, New York.

zh.s: 扬宅战役又称扬宅角战斗、扬宅宅邸事件或扬宅角行动，是美国独立战争期间英美军队于1780年2月3日在纽约市郊外进行的一次小规模交战。英军袭击并摧毁了纽约州韦斯特切斯特县的一处大陆军前哨。

en.s: The Battle of Faenza, also known as the Battle of Castel Bolognese on 3 February 1797, saw 7,000 troops from the Papal Army commanded by Michelangelo Alessandro Colli-Marchi face 9,000 troops from the French Army under the command of Claude-Victor Perrin. The veteran French troops quickly overran the Papal army, inflicting disproportionate casualties.

zh.s: 法恩扎战役又称1797年2月3日的卡斯特尔博洛涅塞战役。教皇国军队由米开朗基罗·亚历山德罗·科利—马尔基指挥，共7000人；法军由克洛德—维克多·佩兰指挥，共9000人。经验丰富的法军迅速击溃教皇国军队，并造成对方远高于自身的伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Montevideo took place between the British and Spanish Empires during the Napoleonic Wars, in which British forces captured the city of Montevideo. It formed part of the British invasions of the River Plate. Locally, it is known as the siege of Montevideo (Spanish: Sitio de Montevideo).

zh.s: 蒙得维的亚战役发生在拿破仑战争期间，交战双方是英国帝国和西班牙帝国，最终英军攻占了蒙得维的亚。该战役是英国入侵拉普拉塔河地区的一部分，当地称之为蒙得维的亚围城战（西班牙语：Sitio de Montevideo）。

en.s: The Battle of Allenstein (or Olsztyn), also known as the Battle of Jonkowo (or Jankowo, Inkowo, Jonkendorf) and the Battle of Bergfriede, was a military engagement during the early stages of the 1807 Fourth Coalition Napoleonic campaign. While the battle resulted in a French field victory and allowed for a successful pursuit of the Russian army, it failed to produce the decisive engagement that Napoleon was seeking.

zh.s: 阿伦施泰因战役又称奥尔什丁战役、扬科沃（又称詹科沃、因科沃或扬肯多夫）战役和贝格弗里德战役，是1807年第五次反法同盟战争初期拿破仑战役中的一场军事交战。法军取得战场胜利，并成功追击俄军，但未能打成拿破仑所寻求的决定性战役。

en.s: The 10th United States Congress was a meeting of the legislative branch of the United States federal government, consisting of the Senate and the House of Representatives. It met in Washington, D.C., from March 4, 1807, to March 4, 1809, during the seventh and eighth years of Thomas Jefferson's presidency. The apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives was based on the 1800 census; both chambers had an overwhelming Democratic-Republican majority.
en.n: The Territory of Illinois is created by the 10th United States Congress.

zh.s: 美国第十届国会由参议院和众议院组成，是美国联邦政府的立法机构，1807年3月4日至1809年3月4日在华盛顿特区开会，正值托马斯·杰斐逊总统任期的第七和第八年。众议院席位根据1800年人口普查结果分配；两院都由民主共和党占据压倒性多数。
zh.n: 美国第十届国会设立伊利诺伊领地。

en.t: On February 3, 1809, the 10th United States Congress passed legislation establishing the Illinois Territory, after Congress received petitions from residents in the Mississippi River areas complaining of the difficulties of participating in territorial affairs in Indiana Territory
en.s: The Territory of Illinois was an organized incorporated territory of the United States that existed from March 1, 1809, until December 3, 1818, when the southern portion of the territory was admitted to the Union as the State of Illinois. Its capital was the former French village of Kaskaskia on the Mississippi River (which is still a part of the State of Illinois).

zh.t: 美国国会于1809年2月3日通过法案，设立伊利诺伊领地
zh.s: 伊利诺伊领地是美国正式设立的一个领地，存在于1809年3月1日至1818年12月3日。1818年，领地南部加入联邦，成为伊利诺伊州。领地首府是密西西比河畔的法国旧村卡斯卡斯基亚，该地如今仍属于伊利诺伊州。

en.s: The action of 3 February 1812 was a single-ship action fought off the western coast of Haiti between the British Royal Navy and a Haitian warship during the Napoleonic Wars. It was fought against the background of the collapse of the First Empire of Haiti in 1806 after the Haitian Revolution.

zh.s: 1812年2月3日海战是拿破仑战争期间英国皇家海军与一艘海地军舰在海地西岸附近进行的一场单舰交战。当时1806年海地革命后建立的第一帝国已瓦解。

en.s: The Battle of San Lorenzo was fought on February 3, 1813 in San Lorenzo, Argentina, then part of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata. A Spanish Royalist force under the command of Antonio Zabala was defeated by the Regiment of Mounted Grenadiers, under the command of José de San Martín. This battle was the baptism of fire for this military unit, and for San Martín in the Spanish American wars of independence. Montevideo, a royalist stronghold during the Argentine War of Independence, was under siege by José Gervasio Artigas. Those in the city raided population centres along the nearby rivers for supplies.

zh.s: 1813年2月3日，圣洛伦索战役发生在今天阿根廷的圣洛伦索，当时该地属于拉普拉塔联合省。何塞·德·圣马丁指挥的骑马掷弹兵团，击败安东尼奥·萨瓦拉率领的西班牙保王军。这是该部队以及圣马丁本人在西属美洲独立战争中的首次实战。当时，阿根廷独立战争中的保王派据点蒙得维的亚正遭何塞·赫尔瓦西奥·阿蒂加斯围困，城内守军因而袭击附近河流沿岸的居民点，抢夺补给。

en.s: The London Protocol of 1830, also known as the Protocol of Independence (Greek: Πρωτόκολλο της Ανεξαρτησίας) in Greek historiography, was a treaty signed between France, Russia, and Great Britain on 3 February 1830. It was the first official international diplomatic act that recognized Greece as a fully sovereign and independent state, separate from the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 1830年伦敦议定书又称《独立议定书》（希腊史学称：Πρωτόκολλο της Ανεξαρτησίας），是法国、俄罗斯和英国于1830年2月3日签署的一项条约。这是第一个正式承认希腊为完全主权独立国家、使其脱离奥斯曼帝国的国际外交文件。

en.s: The Battle of Caseros was fought near the town of Caseros, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, on 3 February 1852, between the Army of Buenos Aires commanded by Juan Manuel de Rosas and the Grand Army (Ejército Grande) led by Justo José de Urquiza. The forces of Urquiza, caudillo and governor of Entre Ríos, defeated Rosas, who fled to the United Kingdom. This defeat marked a sharp division in the history of Argentina. As provisional Director of the Argentine Confederation, Urquiza sponsored the creation of the Constitution in 1853, and became the first constitutional President of Argentina in 1854.

zh.s: 1852年2月3日，胡安·曼努埃尔·德·罗萨斯指挥的布宜诺斯艾利斯军，与胡斯托·何塞·德·乌尔基萨率领的大军，在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯省卡塞罗斯镇附近交战。恩特雷里奥斯省省长兼地方强人乌尔基萨的部队获胜，罗萨斯逃往英国。这场失败成为阿根廷历史的重要分界。乌尔基萨出任阿根廷邦联临时领导人，推动制定1853年宪法，并于1854年成为阿根廷首位宪政总统。

zh.s: 普拉廷战争（西班牙语：Guerra Platina；葡萄牙语：Guerra do Prata、Guerra contra Oribe e Rosas）于1851年8月18日至1852年2月3日进行，交战双方是阿根廷邦联与巴西帝国、乌拉圭以及阿根廷的恩特雷里奥斯省和科连特斯省组成的联盟。巴拉圭共和国也作为巴西的共同交战方和盟友参战。

en.t: New York legislature elects Preston King to the US Senate
en.s: On February 3, 1857, the New York State Legislature elected Republican Preston King to the United States Senate. Incumbent Hamilton Fish did not seek re-election.

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 27 January 1861, with a second round on 3 February. The newly elected Parliament first convened in Turin on 4 March 1861, where, thirteen days later, it declared the unification of the country as the Kingdom of Italy. The elections were carried out according to the 1848 electoral law of the Kingdom of Sardinia, in which only literate men over the age of 25 and paying a certain level of taxation were allowed to vote.

zh.s: 意大利于1861年1月27日举行大选，并于2月3日进行第二轮投票。新当选的议会于1861年3月4日在都灵首次召开，13天后宣布意大利统一，建立意大利王国。选举依据1848年撒丁王国选举法进行，只有年满25岁、识字且达到一定纳税标准的男性可以投票。

en.s: Battle of Węgrów was one of the most important skirmishes of January Uprising in the Russian Partition of Poland. It took place February 3, 1863 near Węgrów in east Masovia. On January 22, Polish partisans liberated a town from Russians forces. Here Poles established a military base, in a few days gathering almost 3,500 soldiers. But the Russians decided to recapture Węgrów by rapid attack force composed of a 1,000-strong unit with artillery, led by colonel Georgi Papaafanasopulo. The Poles were threatened by encirclement, and Polish commander Jan Matliński ordered a retreat from the town.

zh.s: 文格鲁夫战役是俄占波兰一月起义中最重要的交战之一，于1863年2月3日在马佐夫舍东部文格鲁夫附近发生。1月22日，波兰游击队从俄军手中解放该镇，建立军事基地，几天内聚集近3500人。俄军决定以快速进攻夺回文格鲁夫，派格奥尔基·帕帕阿法纳索普洛上校率1000名士兵和炮兵出击。波军面临被包围的危险，指挥官扬·马特林斯基下令撤离该镇。

en.s: The Battle of Königshügel (Danish: Kampene ved Kongshøj), also known as the Battle of Ober-Selk fought on 3 February 1864, was a battle in the Second Schleswig War where Austrian Major General Gondrecourt and his infantry brigade succeeded in occupying the area in front of the Danevirke near Ober-Selk (Danish: Øvre Selk) and taking the strategically important village of Königshügel (Danish: Kongshøj).

en.s: The Battle of Rivers' Bridge, also known as Salkehatchie River, Hickory Hill, Owen's Crossroads, Lawtonville, and Duck Creek, was a Union victory fought on February 3, 1865, during the Carolinas Campaign of the American Civil War. While Maj. Gen. William T. Sherman's Union armies marched north across South Carolina, about 1,200 Confederates under Maj. Gen. Lafayette McLaws were posted at the crossing on the Salkehatchie River. Union soldiers began to build bridges to bypass McLaws on February 2. The next day two brigades under Maj. Gen. Francis P. Blair waded through the swamp and flanked the Confederates.

zh.s: 里弗斯桥战役也称萨尔克哈奇河、希科里山、欧文十字路口、劳顿维尔或达克溪战役，发生于美国内战卡罗来纳战役期间的1865年2月3日，以联邦军获胜告终。威廉·T.谢尔曼少将率联邦军北上穿越南卡罗来纳州时，拉法耶特·麦克劳斯少将指挥约1200名联盟军扼守萨尔克哈奇河渡口。联邦军于2月2日开始架桥，企图绕过守军。次日，弗朗西斯·P.布莱尔少将麾下两个旅涉过沼泽，迂回至联盟军侧翼。

en.t: Fifteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Fifteenth Amendment (Amendment XV) to the United States Constitution prohibits the federal government or any state from denying or abridging a citizen's right to vote "on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude." It was ratified on February 3, 1870, as the third and last of the Reconstruction Amendments.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十五修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十五修正案（第十五条修正案）禁止联邦政府或任何州以公民的种族、肤色或曾受奴役为由，剥夺或限制其投票权。该修正案于1870年2月3日获批准，是重建时期三项修正案中的第三项，也是最后一项。

en.s: The Coro Revolution, also known as the Colinada Revolution, was an armed insurrection led by General León Colina that occurred in Venezuela between October 1874 and February 1875 against the government of Antonio Guzmán Blanco. The conflict was one of the main armed movements against the dictatorship of Antonio Guzmán Blanco. The revolution was led by several liberal political leaders, among them generals León Colina and José Ignacio Pulido.

en.t: Sixteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Sixteenth Amendment (Amendment XVI) to the United States Constitution allows Congress to levy an income tax without apportioning it among the states on the basis of population. It was passed by Congress in 1909 in response to the 1895 Supreme Court case of Pollock v. Farmers' Loan & Trust Co. The Sixteenth Amendment was ratified by the requisite number of states on February 3, 1913, and effectively overruled the Supreme Court's ruling in Pollock.

en.s: The Dromkeen ambush took place on 3 February 1921, during the Irish War of Independence, at Dromkeen in County Limerick. The Irish Republican Army (IRA) ambushed a Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC) patrol, killing 11 policemen. The ambush was carried out by the flying columns of the East and Mid Limerick Brigades IRA, some 45 riflemen, under the command of Donnocha O'Hannigan commander of East Limerick Brigade Flying Column. Some time earlier the RIC had found the arms dump of the Mid-Limerick Brigade. Only one IRA volunteer—Liam Hayes—was wounded. Only two of the RIC got away.

en.n: February 3 is the recognized founding anniversary. The official party history describes the conference as running from January 6 to early February and says the 1960 congress selected February 3 for the anniversary.

en.s: The Battle of Port Moresby was an aerial battle fought between the Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) and United States Army Air Force (USAAF) on one side and the Imperial Japanese Army and Imperial Japanese Navy on the other between 3 February 1942 and 17 August 1943 over Port Moresby, Papua. At the start, the defenders consisted only of Australian Army anti-aircraft batteries and machine-guns, but by late March had been strengthened by the arrival of Kittyhawk fighters from No. 75 Squadron RAAF. However, in just nine days they lost 11 aircraft and only the arrival of replacements enabled the unit to maintain ten serviceable machines.

zh.s: 1942年2月3日至1943年8月17日，澳大利亚皇家空军和美国陆军航空军，与日本帝国陆军及海军在巴布亚莫尔兹比港上空展开空战。守方起初仅有澳大利亚陆军的高射炮和机枪，到3月底，澳空军第75中队的“小鹰”战斗机抵达，防御力量才得到加强。但该中队仅九天就损失11架飞机，只靠后续补充，才勉强维持十架可用飞机。

en.s: The Battle of Manila (February 3, 1945 – March 3, 1945) was a major battle of the Philippine campaign of 1944-45 during World War II that was fought by the American and Filipino forces against the Empire of Japan in Manila, the capital city of the Philippines. The one-month battle, which culminated in the massacre of over 100,000 civilians and complete devastation of the city, was the scene of the worst urban fighting in the Pacific theater. Along with the massive loss of lives, the battle also destroyed architectural and cultural heritage dating back since the city's foundation.

zh.s: 1945年2月3日至3月3日，美军和菲律宾军队在菲律宾首都马尼拉与日本帝国军队交战。这是二战1944—1945年菲律宾战役的一场主要战斗。持续一个月的战事最终伴随超过十万平民遭屠杀，以及全城遭到毁灭性破坏，成为太平洋战场最惨烈的城市战。除大量人员死亡外，自城市建立以来积累的建筑和文化遗产也遭毁坏。

en.s: The Batepá massacre occurred on 3 February 1953 in colonial São Tomé when hundreds of native creoles known as forros were massacred by the colonial administration and Portuguese landowners. Many forros believed the government intended to force them to work as contract laborers, to which they objected. In response, the governor blamed the unrest on communists and ordered the military to round up such individuals and for civilians to protect themselves.

en.s: American Airlines Flight 320 was a scheduled flight between Chicago Midway Airport and New York City's LaGuardia Airport. On February 3, 1959, the Lockheed L-188 Electra operating the flight crashed into the East River as it approached LaGuardia, killing 65 of the 73 people on board. The aircraft descended through dense clouds and fog, and during its final approach, it flew below the intended glide path before striking the icy river 4,900 feet (1,500 m) short of the runway.

en.s: General elections were held in Pakistan on 3 February 1997 to elect the National Assembly of Pakistan and the four provincial assemblies. The election featured a fierce contest between ruling Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) led by incumbent Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto and the PML(N) led by conservative leader Nawaz Sharif. Nawaz Sharif was highly benefited and aided by the controversial death of populist leader Murtaza Bhutto, the worsening economy at home, and won the election in a landslide, receiving the highest number of votes ever won by a nonincumbent prime ministerial candidate. Sharif subsequently became the 12th prime minister of Pakistan.

'Cermis massacre'), occurred on 3 February 1998, near the Italian town of Cavalese, a ski resort in the Dolomites some 40 kilometres (25 mi) northeast of Trento. en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on February 3, 2002. For the first time in the country's history, no candidate in the presidential election passed the 40% threshold. This meant a second round of voting had to be held on April 7, which saw Abel Pacheco of the Social Christian Unity Party defeat the National Liberation Party's Rolando Araya Monge. Many analysts consider this election the beginning of the end of Costa Rica’s decades-long two party system. For the first time in many years alternative political forces become really relevant in the Parliament and the plenary had three large party groups; PUSC (19), PLN (17) and PAC (14).

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于2002年2月3日举行大选，历史上首次没有总统候选人达到40%的得票门槛，因此于4月7日举行第二轮投票。基督教社会团结党的阿韦尔·帕切科击败民族解放党的罗兰多·阿拉亚·蒙赫。许多分析人士将这次选举视为哥斯达黎加延续数十年的两党制开始瓦解的标志。多年来，其他政治力量首次在议会中占据重要地位，形成三个较大的党团：基督教社会团结党19席、民族解放党17席、公民行动党14席。

en.s: A pre-term presidential election was held in Serbia on January 20 and February 3, 2008. The election for president was the first since Serbia became independent, when the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro was dissolved by the secession of Montenegro in 2006. The first round of elections was held on January 20, 2008, when none of the candidates secured an absolute majority of the votes cast.
